title: Chapter 2: Querying (features/02_querying)
description: Querying implemented with SQLite and the sqlite-vec extension underneath. The engine is completely invisible to callers: one query interface, with different query functions on one class and SQLite underneath, so callers never see which engine is running. Supersedes the old property-based filtering over in-memory objects from the former features/03_query_export chapter. Implementation of record: BOTSPY-c7795b (Local Store Initiative). Specs first: features/02_querying/*.feature.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementation plan for this chapter is filed under the initiative of record, BOTSPY-c7795b: store foundation (SQLite + sqlite-vec + FTS5, cross-platform), ingestion + unified iteration, incremental refresh, filters + laziness, text + vector search, MiniLM embeddings (deferred on open asset questions), docs wrap-up. The existing @wip specs (01_iteration, 02_filters, 03_laziness) turn green as the query-interface epics land; new store / ingest / refresh / search specs join the same folder (features/02_querying/).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Chapter complete: every child task is closed; the querying behaviors live in features/02_querying and are green on feat/local-store (PR #4).
